### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: Normalizing the linear sky lattice by `radianceScale = 7.45223323490626` before piecewise sRGB8 encoding compresses the darkest-decile sky values (`[0.18, 0.30]` linear) into `[0.024, 0.040]` normalized linear (`~1.95e-3` MAE vs `8.52e-4` unscaled in `test/playwright/visual/evidence/radiance/numerical.json`). For the bright daylight beach sky (`minimum channel 0.172`), the 12.92× linear toe of sRGB8 keeps quantization well below 1 display code step, but future twilight or night-sky places with higher peak-to-zenith dynamic range (`radianceScale` near `64` and dark regions `< 0.02` linear) would experience visible banding in 8-bit PNG transport and should be watched when `#93` / `#202` expand sky conditions.
